distrusted_roots.reason: eMudhra 'emSign ECC Root CA - G3' (O=eMudhra Technologies Limited). Distrusted following the Mozilla dev-security-policy discussion at https://groups.google.com/a/mozilla.org/g/dev-security-policy/c/0R3XLJL6FuE. Present in Debian Bookworm and Trixie ca-certificates 20250419.

Sectigo 'AAA Certificate Services' (O=Comodo CA Limited), a 2004-era SHA-1-signed RSA-2048 root expiring 2028-12-31, retained upstream only as a legacy cross-signer for USERTrust RSA. Removed from the Mozilla root store; still shipped by Debian as of ca-certificates 20250419. Present in Debian Bookworm and Trixie.

eMudhra 'emSign Root TLS CA - G3' (O=eMudhra Technologies Limited). Same distrust decision as emSign ECC Root CA - G3. Not in the Mozilla root store (Microsoft only), so it does not match anything in a Debian bundle today; listed defensively in case Debian ever picks it up.

eMudhra 'emSign Root CS CA - G3' (O=eMudhra Technologies Limited), a code-signing root. Same distrust decision as emSign ECC Root CA - G3. Not in the Mozilla root store (Microsoft only), so it does not match anything in a Debian bundle today; listed defensively in case Debian ever picks it up.
